vo_open.text: He survived the atomic bomb in Hiroshima.
Three days later, he was in Nagasaki.

vo.text: August sixth, 1945. Tsutomu Yamaguchi was in Hiroshima on a business trip.
He was three kilometers from the blast. It burst his eardrums and burned his upper body.
vo.cap: *3 km* from the blast. Burst eardrums. *Serious burns.*

vo.text: The next day, he went home. To Nagasaki.
vo.cap: The next day, he went home. *To Nagasaki.*

vo.text: On August ninth, he was telling his boss about Hiroshima, when the second bomb exploded.
vo.cap: *August 9:* telling his boss about Hiroshima... when the *second bomb* exploded.

vo.text: He survived again. In 2009, Japan recognized him as a double survivor. He lived to ninety-three.
vo.cap: He survived *again.* Officially a *double survivor* in 2009. He lived to *93.*
